preImplementationSteps:
1. Review code changes and dependencies
2. Backup current database schema
3. Run unit tests and integration tests
4. Coordinate with dependent services
implementationSteps:
1. Deploy to staging environment
2. Run smoke tests
3. Deploy to production with blue-green strategy
4. Monitor application metrics
5. Verify API endpoints are responding correctly
postValidationSteps:
1. Check application logs for errors
2. Verify database connections
3. Run full regression test suite
4. Monitor performance metrics for 30 minutes
5. Confirm with stakeholders
backoutSteps:
1. Switch traffic back to previous version
2. Rollback database changes if necessary
3. Restore previous configuration
4. Verify rollback success
backoutValidationSteps:
1. Check all API endpoints are working
2. Verify database integrity
3. Run critical path tests
4. Confirm system stability
